configTypeName.description: The config type name to assert against.

configKey.description: The field in the config type type to assert against.

expectedValue.description: The expected value of the config field.

title:
Implements {@link UiSdlRenderCondition} for checks against a config value.

If specified in {@link UiSdlConditionalRenderer#condition}, it will render the thenComponent when the
configKey on the configTypeName matches the expectedValue. Otherwise, the elseComponent
will be rendered.
name: GenAiUiConditionalRendererCheckConfigValue
